body.name: Independent desired-exposure law
body.construction: Independently for \(i\in\mathcal I_n\), draw \(U_{n,i}=1\) and \(U_{n,i}=0\) with probability \((4\lambda_n)^{-1}\) each and draw \(U_{n,i}=*\) with probability \(t_n=1-(2\lambda_n)^{-1}\); set \(E_{n,i,k}=\{U_{n,i}=k,\ U_{n,j}=*\text{ for all }j\in B_{n,i}\}\) and \(q_{n,i}=(4\lambda_n)^{-1}t_n^{|B_{n,i}|}\).
